digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center wiki text codec renderer
propositions: Jira Data Center's WikiTextCodec currently passes Markdown through verbatim as identity codec, shipping unrendered rebar prose that loses structure and readability.
Pandoc round-trip conversions corrupt punctuation-dense prose (arrows, tables, regex) monotonically, with ASCII tables decaying per pass (9115→9110 chars observed).

A segmenting one-way renderer that converts only structurally-safe units (headings, lists, code, quotes) to wiki markup while passing dangerous units (tables, arrows, regex) through verbatim achieves ~68% body coverage and ~78% char coverage without corruption.

Code-aware arrow substitution (→ ← ↔ ⇒) must run on Markdown before pandoc to preserve code arrows (obj->method()) while rendering prose arrows, with ASCII tables wrapped in {noformat} to prevent dash erosion.

This story delivers only the pure renderer module (wiki_render.py) and its tests in isolation, leaving WikiTextCodec fully identity and all live send paths untouched; the observable codec cutover is owned by story 3388.
